result.instructions: Tools for Return Prime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which return requests came in this week?"; "What is the status of return RET322, and which items does it cover?"; "Which exchanges were created in October, and who asked for them?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Return Prime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run returnprime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run returnprime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run returnprime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. returnprime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: returnprime_list_requests
tools.title: List return and exchange requests
tools.description: List return and exchange requests from the merchant's Return Prime account, with optional filters. Use request_number to find one request. Each request shows its status, type, order and customer. Return Prime API: GET /return-exchange/v2.

request_number.description: Return Prime request number, e.g. RET322 (returns start with RET, exchanges with EXC).

created_at_min.description: Only requests created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_at_max.description: Only requests created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).
